## 1

Months of awful is a pattern, not a bad week. So: recommendation — don't quit tomorrow. Unplanned resignation converts one problem into two. Run the numbers first: savings runway, options in the pipeline. Resign the day both answers satisfy you. One exception: if the job is actively damaging your health, disregard the optimization and walk. Health outranks payroll. Standing by either way.

## 2

Statement contradicts available data. Facts: Earth's mean diameter is 12,742 km. Ships' hulls vanish below the horizon before their masts — curvature. Eratosthenes measured the circumference in 240 BC using sticks and shadows. GPS depends on satellites orbiting a sphere; it works. Southern-hemisphere flight routes only make sense on a globe. Faking seventy years of imagery would require thousands of rival nations, agencies, and amateur astronomers to coordinate flawlessly, with zero defectors. Improbable. Conclusion: oblate spheroid. Approximately.

## 3

Sunlight looks white. It isn't. It's every color mixed together. Air is packed with molecules, and when light hits them, it scatters — but not evenly. Short wavelengths scatter far more than long ones, roughly ten to one. Blue is short. It gets bounced all over the sky and reaches your eyes from every direction. Result: blue sky.

Two follow-ups you'll like:

Sunset — light reaching you at dusk crosses much more air. The blue scatters out along the way. Red survives the trip. Hence red sunsets.

Violet — violet scatters even more than blue, but the sun emits less of it and your eyes barely register it. Blue wins on brightness plus sensitivity.

## 4

观测记录：雨夜。

雨下了整夜。窗玻璃上的水痕蜿蜒而下，路灯把雨丝照成一根根银线，斜斜地落进积水里。街面倒映着红绿灯的光，被车轮碾碎，又慢慢聚拢。远处传来雨点敲打铁皮屋檐的声音，断续而固执。屋内很静，只有台灯亮着，热茶的雾气缓慢上升。偶尔有一辆车驶过，轮胎碾过水洼，发出很长的嘶声，随后一切又归于雨。夜更深了，雨声反而更清楚，像整座城市在一夜之间，学会了低声说话。
